decisive_items: Basal membrane and stroma inside the papillae were positive for collagen IV
response.rationale: Intravascular papillary structures with hyaline globules and collagen IV-positive papillary cores are hallmark features of Dabska tumor; hobnail hemangioma only overlaps dermoscopically but lacks these diagnostic histologic findings.

rejected.why: Only dermoscopic red lacunae are cited; it does not account for the diagnostic intravascular papillary structures, hyaline globules, or collagen IV-positive papillary cores.
